target_customer: Frontier AI labs and voice AI builders that need licensed conversational audio, annotation and evaluation data
problem: Speech and voice models need diverse, accurately transcribed conversational audio across languages and accents, which is hard to collect and label at human level quality.
business_model: Data licensing plus annotation and evaluation services

founders.name: Yi Zhong
founders.background_notes: PM lead on Meta AI Integrity team per YC page.

founders.name: Bill Wang
founders.background_notes: Led Meta GenAI Annotation team that built an in-house annotation platform for LLaMA per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: An annotation platform and a large collected audio corpus need solid engineering and operations, but components are standard and founders came from Meta annotation teams.

defensibility.rationale: A proprietary corpus of millions of hours (company claim) and licensing deals can compound, but labeling services are easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found through 2026.

market_need_then: Voice AI and speech model training drove demand for conversational audio data in 2025. The company says frontier labs are customers, unverified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, with the YC description ending 'Audio data should besimple :)'

brand_strength.rationale: Name states the promise but is easily confused with other Simple AI companies, and no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Besimple raised a reported 3 million dollar seed after YC Spring 2025 and positions as an audio data research lab for frontier labs. Founders came from Meta annotation teams, which fits the market, while competition from Scale AI and Surge is strong and the company is still early.
notes: Seed date conflicts: Nov 2025 on seedtable and Caplight, announcement around 26 Nov or 1 Dec 2025 per search summaries, Feb 2026 on one aggregator. YC page says a seed round led by Y Combinator was announced December 2025. Investor names beyond Y Combinator (Amino Capital, Team Ignite, Script Capital, Multimodal Ventures) appear in one profile only and are unverified. A 500K pre-seed in July 2025 and 440K ARR appear in one aggregator only, unverified. Competitor sources are 2024 roundups, not audio specific. Stage taken from aggregators and the YC page.
